frontMatter.welcome:
Welcome to Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH.
We are pleased to welcome you to our team and look forward to working together in a professional, respectful, and quality-focused environment.
Since 1991, Prestige Promotion has been providing reliable pharmaceutical secondary packaging, rework, warehousing, and logistics services to customers within the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors. Our operations are guided by high quality standards, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and responsible business practices.
Every employee contributes to our success. Whether working in production, warehouse operations, administration, quality management, or leadership functions, your work plays an important role in maintaining the trust of our customers and business partners.
This Employee Handbook has been prepared to help you understand:
- Our company values and expectations,
- Workplace policies and responsibilities,
- Health and safety requirements,
- Employee benefits and development opportunities, and
- General company procedures.
We encourage all employees to contribute to a safe, respectful, and collaborative working environment.
We wish you success and a positive experience at Prestige Promotion
Prestige Promotion specializes in:
- Pharmaceutical secondary packaging,
- Repackaging and rework activities,
- Warehousing and logistics services, and
- Customized support solutions for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.
Our company operates in accordance with applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and quality management standards.
We are committed to:
- Quality and customer satisfaction,
- Ethical and responsible business conduct,
- Environmental sustainability,
- Employee health and safety,
- Human rights and equal opportunity, and

chapters.title: Overtime Compensation
chapters.text:
Where applicable, approved overtime may be compensated through:
- Additional payment in accordance with employment agreements and applicable legal requirements, or
- Compensatory time off arrangements.
The company regularly monitors overtime practices and working hours to:
- Support employee wellbeing,
- Maintain operational efficiency,
- Prevent excessive working hours, and
- Ensure fair and transparent working conditions.
Employees are expected to cooperate professionally during operational peak periods while maintaining compliance with workplace safety and working time requirements.
## Flexible Work & Remote Working Arrangements
Prestige Promotion recognizes the importance of balancing operational requirements with reasonable employee flexibility where possible.
## Remote Work Eligibility
Remote or home office arrangements may be permitted for employees in administrative or non-production functions depending on:
- Operational feasibility,
- Departmental requirements,
- Data confidentiality considerations,
- Employee responsibilities, and
- Management approval.
Production and warehouse activities generally require onsite presence due to GMP, operational, and quality requirements.
## Employee Responsibilities During Remote Work
Employees working remotely remain responsible for:
- Maintaining productivity and communication,
- Following company policies and confidentiality obligations,
- Remaining available during agreed working hours, and
- Protecting company information and systems.
## Family-Friendly Workplace & Employee Support Measures
Prestige Promotion recognizes the importance of supporting employees in balancing their professional responsibilities with personal and family commitments.
The company aims to maintain a respectful and supportive working environment that promotes employee wellbeing, work-life balance, and equal opportunity.
## Family-Friendly Support Measures
[table]
| Support Area | Company Practice |
| Flexible Working Arrangements | Flexible work schedules or remote work arrangements where operationally feasible |
| Parental Leave Support | Leave arrangements provided in accordance with applicable legal requirements |
| Family & Care Responsibilities | Reasonable consideration of personal and caregiving responsibilities where possi |
| Work-Life Balance | Promotion of responsible workload management and employee wellbeing |
## Employee Wellbeing & Family Support
Prestige Promotion aims to support employees through workplace practices intended to encourage:
- Responsible work-life balance,
- Respectful treatment of employees with family responsibilities,
- Equal opportunity and non-discrimination,
- Employee wellbeing and workplace safety, and
- Compliance with applicable labour and social protection requirements.
Where operationally feasible and legally applicable, the company may provide:
- Flexible scheduling arrangements,
- Temporary workplace adjustments,
- Leave arrangements related to parental or caregiving responsibilities, and
The company does not tolerate unfair treatment, discrimination, or retaliation against employees related to maternity, parental responsibilities, or legally protected leave situations.
## Compensation, Payroll & Employee Benefits
Prestige Promotion aims to provide fair and transparent compensation structures aligned with employee responsibilities, qualifications, and operational requirements.
## Compensation Overview
[table]
| Area | Description |
| Salary Structure | Based on role, experience, qualifications, and responsibilities |
| Salary Payment | Processed according to company payroll schedule |
| Overtime Compensation | Paid or compensated through time off where applicable |
| Bonus Payments | Performance-related or voluntary special payments |
| Salary Reviews | May include inflation and business-related considerations |
## Equal Pay & Fair Remuneration Practices
Prestige Promotion is committed to fair and equitable remuneration practices and supports the principle of equal pay for equal work.
Compensation decisions are based on objective factors such as:
- Job responsibilities,
- Qualifications,
- Professional experience,
- Skills and competencies,
- Performance, and
- Operational requirements.
The company does not tolerate unfair discrimination in remuneration practices.

chapters.title: Business Travel & Expense Reimbursement
chapters.text:
Employees may be required to travel for operational, training, customer, or business-related purposes.
## Reimbursement Principles
[table]
| Reimbursable Items | Examples |
| Transportation Costs | Train, approved mileage, business travel |
| Accommodation | Approved business-related overnight stays |
| Business Expenses | Approved operational expenses with receipts |
Employees are expected to:
- Obtain necessary approvals where required,
- Submit expense claims on time,
- Provide supporting receipts and documentation, and
- Follow internal reimbursement procedures.
The company encourages environmentally responsible travel practices wherever operationally possible, including preference for rail transportation and efficient travel planning.
## PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT, LEARNING & INTERNAL GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES
At Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH, we believe that employee development, continuous learning, and internal career opportunities are important contributors to long-term company success and operational excellence.
The company encourages employees to strengthen their professional skills, expand their knowledge, and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of our operations, quality standards, and workplace culture.
## Employee Learning & Professional Development
Prestige Promotion supports continuous employee learning through internal and external development opportunities designed to strengthen professional competencies, operational knowledge, compliance awareness, and leadership capabilities.
## Development & Training Opportunities
[table]
| Development Area | Company Support |
| GMP & Compliance Training | Regular GMP, quality, and compliance-related training programs |
| Occupational Safety Training | Workplace safety and risk-awareness training |
| Technical Skill Development | Machinery, operational systems, and process-related training |
| Internal Training Programs | Department-specific operational and procedural training |
| External Seminars & Workshops | Participation in professional external training programs where applicable |
| Leadership Development | Development opportunities for employees with leadership potential |
## Employee Development Approach
Employees may be encouraged to:
- Improve technical and operational competencies,
- Participate in refresher and compliance training,
- Expand cross-functional knowledge,
- Develop leadership and communication skills, and
- Contribute to operational and process improvements.
## nternal Career Progression & Growth Opportunities
Prestige Promotion aims to support long-term employee growth by encouraging internal career development and providing opportunities for increased responsibilities where operationally appropriate.
## nternal Growth Principles
[table]
| Growth Area | Company Approach |

| Performance Recognition | Performance, reliability, teamwork, and competencies may support advancement opp |

Employees who demonstrate:

- Reliability,
- Operational knowledge,
- Leadership potential,
- Compliance awareness, and
- Positive teamwork

## Cross-Functional Learning & Internal Mobility
Prestige Promotion recognizes the value of cross-functional knowledge and operational flexibility.
Where operationally feasible, employees may have opportunities to broaden their experience by supporting or learning activities across different functions or departments.
## nternal Mobility & Cross-Skilling

Prestige Promotion supports fair and transparent recruitment and career opportunity practices.

chapters.title: Recruitment Practices, Fair Selection & Performance Management
chapters.text:
Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH is committed to maintaining fair, transparent, and professional recruitment and employee evaluation practices.
The company supports equal opportunity, objective hiring decisions, responsible workforce planning, and performance-based employee development while promoting a respectful and inclusive working environment.
## Recruitment & Employee Selection Process
Prestige Promotion follows structured recruitment and employee selection procedures designed to identify qualified candidates based on professional competencies, operational suitability, experience, and business requirements.
## Recruitment Process Overview
[table]
| Recruitment Stage | Company Practice |
| Vacancy Identification | Positions are opened based on operational and business requirements |
| Job Advertising | Vacancies may be communicated internally and/or externally where appropriate |
| Candidate Screening | Applications reviewed based on qualifications, experience, and job-related compe |
| Interview Process | Structured interviews conducted by responsible personnel or management |
| Final Selection | Hiring decisions based on suitability, experience, competencies, and operational |
The company aims to maintain recruitment processes that are:
- Professional,
- Transparent,
- Fair,
- Competency-based, and
- Aligned with operational and compliance requirements.
## Equal Opportunity & Non-Discriminatory Hiring Practices
Prestige Promotion is committed to equal opportunity and fair treatment throughout all recruitment and employment activities.
Employment-related decisions are made without discrimination based on:
- Gender,
- Nationality,
- Ethnic background,
- Religion,
- Age,
- Disability,
- Sexual orientation, or
- Other legally protected characteristics.
## Fair Recruitment Principles
[table]
| Area | Company Commitment |
| Equal Opportunity | Fair consideration of all qualified applicants |
| Merit-Based Evaluation | Selection based on qualifications, competencies, and operational suitability |
| Non-Discrimination | No tolerance for discriminatory hiring practices |
| Professional Conduct | Respectful and professional treatment of applicants |
The company encourages a respectful and inclusive recruitment environment and supports diversity within the workforce.
## Fair Compensation & Responsible Hiring Practices
Prestige Promotion aims to maintain responsible and fair compensation practices aligned with employee responsibilities, qualifications, experience, and operational requirements.
## Compensation & Hiring Principles
[table]
| Area | Company Practice |
| Salary Determination | Based on role requirements, qualifications, experience, and responsibilities |
| Internal Consistency | Compensation structures reviewed for fairness and consistency |
| Equal Pay Principle | Support for equal pay for equal work |
| Objective Evaluation | Hiring and compensation decisions based on professional criteria |
The company does not support unfair or discriminatory remuneration practices and seeks to maintain transparent and responsible compensation structures.
Prestige Promotion supports continuous employee improvement through regular performance discussions, operational feedback, and professional development opportunities.
## Performance Review Objectives
[table]
| Review Area | Purpose |
| Performance Evaluation | Review of employee performance and operational contribution |
| Development Discussions | Identification of strengths and improvement opportunities |
| Skills Enhancement | Support for additional learning and competency development |
| Career Growth | Consideration of future responsibilities and development opportunities |
Employee evaluations may consider:
- Work quality,
- Reliability,
- Teamwork,
- Compliance awareness,
- Communication,
- Operational performance, and
- Professional conduct.
Performance reviews may support decisions relating to:
- Professional development,
- Training opportunities,
- Increased responsibilities, and
- Career progression within the organization.
## FAIR HIRING PRACTICES & RESPONSIBLE RECRUITMENT STANDARDS
Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH is committed to maintaining a professional, fair, transparent, and non-discriminatory recruitment process.
The company aims to attract qualified employees through objective and competency-based hiring practices while supporting equal opportunity, diversity, professionalism, and responsible workforce development.
Our recruitment and selection processes are designed to ensure that employment-related decisions are based on qualifications, experience, operational suitability, and professional competencies.

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH is committed to maintaining a safe, respectful, ethical, and professionally supportive working environment where employees and relevant stakeholders can raise concerns without fear of retaliation or unfair treatment.
## Scope of Workplace Concerns & Reportable Issues
This reporting mechanism applies to employees and, where applicable, relevant external stakeholders associated with Prestige Promotion.
Concerns may relate to, but are not limited to, the following areas:
## Reportable Workplace Concerns
[table]
| Concern Area | Examples |
| Workplace Health & Safety | Unsafe working conditions, safety risks, accidents, hazardous situations |
| Harassment & Discrimination | Bullying, harassment, intimidation, discriminatory behaviour |
| Working Conditions | Excessive working hours, unfair treatment, inappropriate workplace conduct |
| Human Rights Concerns | Forced labour, child labour, unethical treatment, violations of employee rights |
| Ethical & Compliance Concerns | Corruption, bribery, fraud, conflicts of interest, policy violations |
| Compensation Concerns | Wage-related concerns, overtime disputes, unfair deductions |
| Environmental Concerns | Improper waste handling, environmental non-compliance, sustainability concerns |
| Retaliation Concerns | Retaliation related to reporting concerns or participating in investigations |
The company encourages employees to report concerns in good faith so that appropriate review and corrective actions can be taken where necessary.
## Core Principles of the Reporting & Grievance Process
Prestige Promotion aims to maintain a grievance process that is accessible, fair, confidential, and professionally managed.
## Reporting Process Principles
[table]
| Principle | Company Commitment |
| Accessibility | Reporting channels available to employees and relevant stakeholders |
| Fair Treatment | Concerns reviewed objectively and responsibly |
| Confidentiality | Information handled with appropriate confidentiality |
| Non-Retaliation | Protection for individuals reporting concerns in good faith |
| Responsible Review | Appropriate evaluation and follow-up actions where necessary |
## Accessibility & Employee Support
The company aims to ensure that employees:
- Have access to reporting channels,
- Understand how to raise concerns,
- Can communicate concerns without fear of retaliation, and
- Receive professional and respectful treatment during the review process.
Information regarding reporting procedures may be communicated through:
- Employee handbooks,
- Internal policies,
- Employee communication channels,
- Management guidance, and
- Workplace training activities.
## Confidentiality & Protection Against Retaliation
Prestige Promotion handles reported concerns with appropriate confidentiality and professional discretion.
The company strictly prohibits retaliation against individuals who:
- Report concerns in good faith,
- Participate in investigations,
- Cooperate in workplace reviews, or
- Support grievance resolution processes.
Any confirmed retaliatory behaviour may result in disciplinary action in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulations.
## Reporting Channels & Internal Communication
Employees are encouraged to report concerns through appropriate internal communication channels.
## Available Reporting Channels
[table]
| Reporting Method | Contact Point |
| Direct Reporting | Supervisor or Department Manager |
| Human Resources | HR Department or responsible HR personnel |
| Management Reporting | Company Management |
| Confidential Reporting | Internal confidential reporting channels |
| Whistleblower Reporting | Internal HinSchG reporting process where applicable |
As confirmed under the company’s Whistleblower Protection procedures, employees may also use confidential reporting channels where legally applicable.
## Confidential Reporting Contacts
[table]
| Reporting Channel | Contact Information |
| E-Mail Reporting | hinweis@prestigepromotion.de |
| Telephone Reporting | +49 6023-40586-63 |
| Additional Contact | +49 171-8183868 |
All reports are expected to be submitted honestly and in good faith.
## Concern Review, Investigation & Resolution Process
Prestige Promotion aims to review reported concerns in a timely, fair, and responsible manner.
## Grievance Handling Process
[table]
| Process Stage | Company Approach |
| Receipt of Concern | Report acknowledged and documented where appropriate |
| Preliminary Review | Initial assessment of the reported concern |
| Investigation | Review conducted by responsible personnel or management |
| Corrective Measures | Appropriate action implemented where necessary |
| Closure & Follow-Up | Resolution process completed and documented where applicable |
Depending on the nature and seriousness of the concern, investigations may involve:
- Human Resources,
- Management,
- Compliance-related personnel,
- External specialists where necessary, or

chapters.title: Whistleblower Procedure
chapters.text:
Prestige Promotion Verkaufsförderung & Werbeservice GmbH is committed to maintaining high standards of integrity, transparency, ethical conduct, and legal compliance across all business activities.
Prestige Promotion supports a reporting culture where concerns can be raised responsibly, confidentially, and without fear of retaliation.
The company’s whistleblower procedures are aligned with the German Whistleblower Protection Act (HinSchG) and related compliance obligations.
## Purpose & Scope of the Whistleblower Process
The whistleblower process is intended to support the responsible reporting, review, and handling of serious concerns that may affect:
- Employees,
- Business operations,
- Compliance obligations,
- Human rights,
- Workplace integrity,
- Environmental responsibilities, or
- Ethical business conduct.
## Types of Reportable Concerns
[table]
| Concern Area | Examples |
| Ethical Misconduct | Corruption, bribery, fraud, conflicts of interest |
| Human Rights Concerns | Forced labour, child labour, unethical treatment |
| Workplace Misconduct | Harassment, discrimination, retaliation |
| Compliance Violations | Breaches of company policies or legal obligations |
| Environmental Concerns | Improper waste handling or environmental non-compliance |
| Financial Irregularities | Misuse of company resources or dishonest practices |
| Information Security Concerns | Unauthorized disclosure or misuse of confidential information |
The company encourages reporting in good faith and does not tolerate knowingly false or intentionally misleading reports.
## Confidential Reporting Channels
Prestige Promotion has established confidential reporting channels through which employees may report concerns securely and responsibly.
## Available Reporting Channels
[table]
| Reporting Method | Contact Information |
| Confidential E-Mail Reporting | hinweis@prestigepromotion.de |
| Telephone Reporting | +49 6023-40586-63 |
| Additional Contact Number | +49 171-8183868 |
| Direct Reporting | Human Resources, Management, or designated responsible personnel |
As confirmed under the company’s whistleblower procedures, reports may be submitted confidentially and handled in accordance with applicable legal and internal requirements.
## Confidentiality & Protection of Reporting Individuals
Prestige Promotion is committed to protecting individuals who report concerns in good faith.
## Protection Principles
[table]
| Area | Company Commitment |
| Confidentiality | Reports handled with appropriate confidentiality and discretion |
| Good Faith Reporting | Protection for individuals reporting concerns honestly and responsibly |
| Restricted Information Access | Information shared only with authorized persons where necessary |
| Data Protection | Responsible handling of personal and sensitive information |
Where legally permissible and operationally appropriate, confidentiality of the reporting individual will be protected throughout the review and investigation process.
## Non-Retaliation Commitment
Prestige Promotion strictly prohibits retaliation against individuals who:
- Report concerns in good faith,
- Participate in investigations,
- Provide information during reviews, or
- Support compliance and reporting activities.
## Non-Retaliation Measures
[table]
| Protected Activities | Company Commitment |
| Reporting Concerns | Employees may raise concerns without fear of retaliation |
| Participation in Investigations | Protection for employees cooperating in reviews |
| Confidential Communication | Respectful and responsible handling of concerns |
| Corrective Action | Appropriate action where retaliation is identified |
Any confirmed retaliatory behaviour may result in disciplinary measures in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulations.
## Review, Investigation & Resolution Process
Prestige Promotion aims to review reported concerns fairly, responsibly, and within an appropriate timeframe.
## Whistleblower Review Process
[table]
| Process Stage | Company Approach |
| Report Receipt | Concern received through approved reporting channels |
| Preliminary Assessment | Initial review of the reported issue |
| Investigation | Evaluation by authorized personnel or responsible parties |
| Corrective Measures | Appropriate actions implemented where necessary |
| Closure & Documentation | Review process completed and documented where applicable |
Depending on the nature of the concern, investigations may involve:
- Human Resources,
- Management,
- Compliance-related personnel,
- External specialists where necessary, or
- Other authorized individuals.
## Corrective Measures & Continuous Improvement
Where violations or misconduct are identified, Prestige Promotion may implement appropriate corrective measures intended to:
- Prevent recurrence,
- Strengthen compliance,
- Improve workplace conditions,
- Protect employees and stakeholders, and
- Support ethical business practices.
